data.title: King Abdulaziz Palace in Historic Laynah Opens to Visitors for 10-Day Heritage Experience
data.content:
Rafha, November 20, 2026, SPA -- The King Abdulaziz Palace in the historic town of Laynah in Northern Borders Region opened to visitors on Thursday with a 10-day heritage experience revisiting key moments in the history of Saudi Arabia and the region, as part of the Darb Zubaida Winter season organized by the Imam Turki bin Abdullah Royal Nature Reserve Development Authority under the theme "Come Visit Us."
    Visitors can explore the site through guided tours on the history of the palace and the region, a museum with rare photographs and artifacts documenting the nation's founding, and heritage activities showcasing local traditions.
    The experience is part of the season's efforts to enrich tourism and heritage offerings and highlight the region's historical and cultural landmarks as part of the nation's collective memory.
    -- SPA
